oauth2.scope: ads:read boards:read boards:write boards:read_secret pins:read pins:write pins:read_secret user_accounts:read

createBoard.label: Create Board
createBoard.description: Create a new Pinterest board for organizing Pins.

ad_account_id.label: Ad Account
ad_account_id.description: Only for ads accounts. Leave empty to use your own account.

is_ads_only.label: Ads-Only Board
is_ads_only.description: Pinterest names it "Ad-only Pins" and makes it protected.

findBoardByName.label: Find Board by Name
findBoardByName.description: Search for boards by name using Pinterest's search API.

ad_account_id.label: Ad Account
ad_account_id.description: Only for ads accounts. Leave empty to use your own account.

bookmark.label: Bookmark
bookmark.description: Bookmark from a previous run to fetch the next page.

findPin.label: Find Pin by Keyword
findPin.description: Search for Pins using title, description, or keywords.

ad_account_id.label: Ad Account
ad_account_id.description: Only for ads accounts. Leave empty to use your own account.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Words in the title, description or tags, or comma-separated Pin IDs.

bookmark.label: Bookmark
bookmark.description: Bookmark from a previous run to continue where it stopped.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Never returns more than this many Pins.

updateBoard.label: Update Board
updateBoard.description: Update a board's name, description, or privacy settings.

ad_account_id.label: Ad Account
ad_account_id.description: Only for ads accounts. Leave empty to use your own account.

name.label: Board Name
name.description: Leave empty to keep the current name.

description.label: Description
description.description: Leave empty to keep the current description.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.description: Leave empty to keep the current setting.

getBoard.label: Get Board
getBoard.description: Read a single board by its id.

board_id.label: Board ID
board_id.description: Numeric board id, as returned by List Boards.

createNewBoard.label: Create New Board
createNewBoard.description: Create a board to organise Pins.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.description: Who can see the board. Defaults to public. Secret boards cannot be created through this connection.

updateBoardDetails.label: Update Board Details
updateBoardDetails.description: Change the name, description or privacy of a board.

board_id.label: Board ID
board_id.description: Numeric board id, as returned by List Boards.

name.label: Board Name
name.description: New name (max 180 characters). Leave empty to keep it.

description.label: Description
description.description: New description (max 500 characters). Leave empty to keep it.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.description: New privacy setting. Leave empty to keep it. A board cannot be switched to secret through this connection.

searchBoards.label: Search Boards
searchBoards.description: Search the account's boards by text.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Text to match against board names and descriptions.

bookmark.label: Bookmark
bookmark.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous call; omit to read the first page.

createBoardSection.label: Create Board Section
createBoardSection.description: Add a section to a board.

board_id.label: Board ID
board_id.description: Numeric board id, as returned by List Boards.

name.label: Section Name
name.description: The name of the new section.

renameBoardSection.label: Rename Board Section
renameBoardSection.description: Change the name of a board section.

board_id.label: Board ID
board_id.description: Numeric board id, as returned by List Boards.

section_id.label: Section ID
section_id.description: Numeric section id, as returned by List Board Sections for this board.

name.label: Section Name
name.description: The new name for the section.

getPin.label: Get Pin
getPin.description: Read a single Pin by its id.

pin_id.label: Pin ID
pin_id.description: Numeric pin id, as returned by List Pins or Search Pins.

pin_metrics.label: Include Metrics
pin_metrics.description: Return 90-day and lifetime metrics alongside the Pin. Total comments and reactions are lifetime-only.

searchPins.label: Search Pins
searchPins.description: Search the account's Pins by text.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Text to match against Pin titles, descriptions and tags. Comma-separated pin ids also work.

bookmark.label: Bookmark
bookmark.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous call; omit to read the first page.

max_results.label: Maximum Results
max_results.description: Return at most this many Pins, 1 to 250. Pinterest has no page-size parameter for Pin search, so further pages are followed until the count is reached.

savePin.label: Save Pin
savePin.description: Save an existing Pin onto a board owned by the account.

pin_id.label: Pin ID
pin_id.description: Numeric id of the Pin to save.

board_id.label: Destination Board ID
board_id.description: Numeric board id to save the Pin onto, as returned by List Boards.

board_section_id.label: Destination Section ID
board_section_id.description: Optional section on that board, as returned by List Board Sections.

getUserAccount.label: Get User Account
getUserAccount.description: Read the profile of the connected Pinterest account.

getUserAccountAnalytics.label: Get Account Analytics
getUserAccountAnalytics.description: Read performance metrics for the whole account.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days after the start date.

metric_types.label: Metrics
metric_types.description: Leave empty to return every available metric.
